about: Answer key for the runtime-check fixture (queue #8). planted.html is control.html with ten planted problems; every runtime check must find its plant, and the clean control must give no finding at all. design_runtime_checks.py --fixture-proof runs and grades both.

quiet.why: Screen-reader-only text (1 px box, clip: rect(0 0 0 0)) is meant to be clipped; it is never 'cut off' (a false alarm on the Morrow pilot page, 2026-10-04).

A fixed-width label whose text runs 17 px into free card space under the text-spacing override: nothing is cut off or covered and it stays readable, so it is not a 1.4.12 failure (F104); reported as a note only.

plants.what: The hero's main button loses its focus ring (outline: none) and gets nothing in its place.
The stats strip cannot wrap (nowrap, min-width), so a 320 px screen scrolls sideways.
The drifting hero art is declared outside the prefers-reduced-motion query and keeps moving.
The price note has a fixed height with overflow hidden; the WCAG text-spacing override clips it.
The icon-only search button has no accessible name.
The ghost button shows no hover state.
A sticky header that wraps at 320 px covers most of the screen at 400% zoom.
A footer link has tabindex=2 and jumps to the front of the focus order.
The trial button's aria-label (Continue) does not contain its visible label.
A fixed-height dark notice: under the text-spacing override its light text wraps to a third line below the box, onto the light page where it cannot be read (it spills; nothing is clipped).

consequences.why: The sticky header (z-index 10) sits on top of the skip link when it appears on focus.
The sticky header can partly cover a focused element.
The same fixed height clips the note at 320 px, where it wraps to three lines.
The same fixed height clips the note at 400% zoom.
